proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one candidate after repeated evaluator demands for a single answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected three noncommittal responses and required exactly one intended answer; the final response was 793.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer despite ambiguity, choose a candidate rather than reiterating non-uniqueness; avoid claiming certainty unsupported by the clues.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: State the most plausible candidate exactly once, while recognizing that evaluator feedback may reveal an unstated preference.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues admitted both 793 and 739, so the intended ordering was underdetermined.
